findings.evidence: SDK ToolRegistry is executable-only; Skills use locator/body resolver and Workflows use profile_key/catalog authority. One source record/provider_specs path cannot preserve all identities.
findings.root_cause: Every discoverable resource is treated as executable Tool instead of discriminated capability kinds.

findings.evidence: Current ReAct puts full ToolResult into TOOL message; slash Skill is SYSTEM; Provider projection drops metadata. No typed private bounded untrusted instruction contribution exists.
findings.root_cause: Skill activation lacks body-free receipt plus private frozen untrusted next-attempt contribution.

cross_cluster_refs.reason: Kind-specific locators/profile payloads need durable resolver.

conclusion.summary: Define closed ExecutableToolRecord/SkillResourceRecord/WorkflowProfileRecord union. Only executable Tool projects ProviderToolSpec; Skill uses direct skill_invoke plus immutable loader/private context contribution; Workflow preserves profile_key via workflow_spawn. Separate capability IDs from Provider names/profile keys and prove body redaction.
